description: Use before sending SOL or paying fees, to confirm the wallet really holds enough. Never rely on a balance remembered from earlier in a conversation. Reads a wallet's native SOL balance directly from the chain. Inputs: wallet: The wallet whose SOL balance to read. network (optional): Solana cluster to read. Defaults to "mainnet-beta" (real funds). Cost: Free (rate-limited). Full field-by-field docs: GET /api/tools/get_solana_balance.
name: get_solana_balance
